summary: Assist to Rocky Mountain National Park (State SAR Coordinator) for an injured 70-year-old man who took a 15-20 ft fall near Estes Cone
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: County unverified; Alpine log (ART mission 2024-103) lists 76 y/o — NPS release + SI retelling say 70 y/o; NPS: notified by a park visitor shortly before noon, RMNP SAR care on scene, CO Army National Guard helo + RMRG hoist, transferred to Med Evac air ambulance at Upper Beaver Meadows.
